blocks.text: Jasmine Hottle, the sister of late actress Kaylee Hottle, will take over the latter’s role in the upcoming film “What Doesn’t Kill Us,” which she was unable to finish following her death last July. This was confirmed by movie producer Andy Mingo in an interview with PEOPLE on Wednesday, Nov. 11. “Like Kaylee, Jasmine is deaf, and her involvement allows us to honor Kaylee’s memory while continuing the work she was going to be part of,” Mingo said. “Kaylee’s passing was an unimaginable tragedy, and her loss is felt deeply by everyone involved with the project,” he added. “When we began discussing […]...
